  "text": "A platform can provide genuine convenience while still extracting attention far beyond the value of that convenience. Because small benefits lower resistance to adoption, companies can later surround those benefits with engagement loops that capture unrelated time. Usefulness must be judged against full cost; one good feature does not justify every attention demand attached to it."
